'''Primitive Longarms''', known internally as '''Shyco''', is a [[Mobs|Mob]] in the [[Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawned after a successful merging between 4 [[Moving Flesh]], through the [[Evolution System]].
*Spawns in groups of 2 to 3, from [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 2|Ubiquitous Development Level 2]] through [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 4|Level 4]], with a spawnweight of 15.
*Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
*Spawned by 4 [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]] stored into a [[Stage III Dispatcher|Stage III]] or [[Stage IV Dispatcher|IV Dispatcher]].
*Spawned by level 4 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when an [[Adapted Longarms]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Primitive Longarms are generic AoE Melee units. 

*Primitive Longarms' Melee Attack inflicts AoE Damage and is performed by them swinging their arms.
*Primitive Longarms have a chance of blocking incoming damage, nullifiyng it.
*If the [[Generations|Generation]] is 4 or higher, Primitive Longarms can perform the following abilities:
**Generate Shockwaves, large damaging areas of disturbed ground. After standing still for a brief period, they will summon a Shockwave which moves forward at slow speed attempting to break any blocks they contact. Shockwaves ignore immunity frames and deal massive vertical knockback.
***This is indicated by flame particles and a sword swinging sound. They will also stand still before performing this attack.
* Primitive Longarms can perform small leaps in liquids.
*Primitive Longarms can dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
*Primitive Longarms can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 1, with a 60 ticks cooldown and 1 Block range.
*On death, Primitive Longarms have a chance to explode, releasing Primitive Remains and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and COTH.
*If a Primitive Longarms gets 10 kills it will evolve into an [[Adapted Longarms]].
{{Variants|count=3|Berserker=BerserkerPriLongarms.png|Virulent=VirulentPriLongarms.png|Breacher=BreacherPriLongarms.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
Primitive Longarms, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
{{Properties
|tier=Primitive
|OrbEffectsMobs=Hunger II (00:15), Slowness II (00:15)
}}

=== ''Post Death'' ===
* On death, Primitive Longarms have a chance to explode into [[Remains|Primitive Remains]], leaving behind an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|Call of the Hive]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Primitive Longarms will become [[Moving Flesh]] upon death instead.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Longarms are inspired by Dead Space's [https://deadspace.fandom.com/wiki/Slasher Slashers] and Doom 3's [https://doom.fandom.com/wiki/Hell_Knight/Doom_3 Hell Knights].
*Longarms are known as '''Shyco''' internally. This is a corruption of "sheep-cow", as a very early design for the Longarms was based on a sheep and cow merged together.
